audience: event and equipment rental businesses that take quotes and bookings in Rental Software

useCases.title: Check item availability for an event
useCases.text: Show the rented and available count of each item on one day. Check availability and price for a start and end time.

useCases.title: Find the most rented items
useCases.text: List the most rented items over the last number of days. List the categories to group them.

useCases.title: Review leads and their totals
useCases.text: List or search leads, then open one lead for its rentals, prices, status, customer and totals.

useCases.title: Create a lead for a customer booking
useCases.text: Create a lead for an event with an existing customer or with customer fields. The event ZIP code is required.

useCases.title: Log a journal entry and create a follow-up task
useCases.text: Add a journal entry to a lead or a customer. Create a task linked to a customer, lead or organization, with an optional reminder.

useCases.title: Read dashboard statistics for a period
useCases.text: Read the dashboard statistics for a time window, such as the last 30 days.
